items.title: ARFORGETECH
items.description: A full-stack technology-services platform that guides clients into professional help, academic project support, and company-specific solution requests. The project includes account flows, structured enquiry forms, responsive service content, production deployment tooling, and search-engine optimization for the Nepal market.

items.title: Barista Bee Coffee School
items.description: A course-discovery and booking platform for a Perth coffee school, built around small-group barista training. It supports course scheduling, secure Stripe payments, coupons, booking administration, automated reminders, certificate generation and verification, editable site content, and SEO-focused public pages.

items.title: Bliss Momos Cafe
items.description: A full-stack café website and reservation system for an Australian venue. Visitors can explore the café and menu, send enquiries, and reserve tables, while staff manage reservations through a calendar-led admin area with users, roles, permissions, email forwarding, and soft-delete recovery workflows.

items.title: Fotoghar
items.description: A media-production portfolio and enquiry platform for photography, film, live streaming, multi-camera production, post-production, studio work, and wedding services. The system includes portfolio management, bookings, consultations, quotes, newsletter subscriptions, editable page content, and an administrative workflow.

items.title: Go Roka Land
items.description: A responsive land and property acquisition website designed to explain the buying process, build trust, and convert visitor interest into qualified enquiries. It includes protected administration, contact management, email forwarding, anti-bot validation, and SEO-oriented public content for the US market.

items.title: Holistic Minds Life Celebration
items.description: A WordPress presence for holistic wellbeing, healing, counselling, meditation, and personal-development services in Nepal. The engagement covered site setup, content presentation, responsive pages, and search-engine optimization.

items.title: Kurakani Cafe
items.description: A full-stack café ordering experience with account authentication, a browsable menu, product options, gallery content, cart and checkout flows, vouchers, customer feedback, order management, and notifications. The backend exposes a GraphQL API backed by Prisma and MariaDB.

items.title: Professional Portfolio Collection
items.description: Three tailored portfolio experiences for Adarsha Pradhan, Bipula Shrestha, and Madhab Poudel. The sites present professional biographies, services, courses, creative work, galleries, media, ventures, and contact information through responsive, personality-led interfaces.

items.title: Burger House Charikot Digital & POS Platform
items.description: A restaurant ecosystem delivered across a public website, web POS, Electron desktop app, and Android/iOS mobile app in a three-week build cycle. It covers dine-in, pickup and delivery orders, tables, KOT/BOT routing, billing and printing, menu and inventory management, customers, staff, attendance, payroll, reports, and role-based access. The engagement also included branch installation and Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok setup.

items.title: Ivy Reign
items.description: A beauty and wellness commerce experience first delivered in WordPress and later migrated to Shopify. The current storefront combines product discovery and online purchasing with ritual-based service reservations, customer accounts, and a responsive editorial presentation.

items.title: Sayteo Marketplace
items.description: An in-progress multi-vendor commerce platform for web and mobile. The codebase covers customer, seller, and administrator experiences; product catalogues and categories; carts, wishlists, checkout, orders, payments, coupons, campaigns, reviews, vendor approval, support messaging, and real-time notifications.

items.title: Third Eye Arts & Crafts
items.description: An in-progress commerce platform for arts, crafts, sacred products, and lifestyle collections. It includes product discovery, comparison, wishlists, cart and checkout, order management, customer accounts, notifications, content-led brand pages, and administration for products, users, orders, access control, enquiries, and site content.
